name: @openlobster/backend
description: OpenLobster is a self-hosted, open-source personal ai autonomous agent platform built with Go and Solid.js, designed to run on your own hardware for maximum privacy and control.

scripts.prepare:embedded-plugins: mkdir -p ./cmd/openlobster/embedded_plugins && rm -f ./cmd/openlobster/embedded_plugins/*.wasm && if [ -d ../../dist/plugins ]; then for id in openlobster-messages-telegram openlobster-messages-discord openlobster-ai-anthropic openlobster-ai-openai openlobster-ai-ollama openlobster-audio-elevenlabs openlobster-memory-gml openlobster-memory-neo4j openlobster-secrets-json openlobster-secrets-openbao; do if [ -f ../../dist/plugins/$id.wasm ]; then cp ../../dist/plugins/$id.wasm ./cmd/openlobster/embedded_plugins/; fi; done; fi
scripts.build:fast: pnpm run prepare:embedded-plugins && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(jq -r '.version' package.json)" -o ../../dist/openlobster ./cmd/openlobster
scripts.build:cross: pnpm run prepare:embedded-plugins && mkdir -p ../../dist/daemon && pnpm run build:darwin-arm64 && pnpm run build:linux-arm64 && pnpm run build:linux-amd64
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: pnpm run prepare:embedded-plugins && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(jq -r '.version' package.json)" -o ../../dist/daemon/openlobster-darwin-arm64 ./cmd/openlobster
scripts.build:linux-arm64: pnpm run prepare:embedded-plugins && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(jq -r '.version' package.json)" -o ../../dist/daemon/openlobster-linux-arm64 ./cmd/openlobster
scripts.build:linux-amd64: pnpm run prepare:embedded-plugins && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(jq -r '.version' package.json)" -o ../../dist/daemon/openlobster-linux-amd64 ./cmd/openlobster
